value.rationale: Degree and coreness are canonical local-versus-embedded network descriptors, and the literature explicitly uses their disagreement to explain peripheral hubs. The smallest connected network in which a single unambiguous degree leader is expelled from the innermost core is therefore a natural structural invariant. The complete first layer being one transparent graph type gives a reusable benchmark for examples, algorithms, and intuition.
